role.title: Regional VP, Middle East and North Africa Operations

business_context.description: Urgent leadership vacancy in MENA regional operations directorate amidst severe geopolitical escalation between Israel and Iran. The role involves managing a high-revenue market (Israel) and a critical supply chain corridor (Strait of Hormuz) simultaneously under conflict conditions.
business_context.urgency_driver: Temporary coverage by Istanbul office is unsustainable beyond 8 weeks; humanitarian relocation of previous VP left a critical gap during active conflict.
business_context.geopolitical_description: Active military escalation between Israel and Iran; instability of US posture in region; closure of traditional logistics corridors; rare earth component supply chain under stress.
business_context.regulatory_description: Sanctions compliance; emergency trade permits; international maritime law; humanitarian relocation protocols.

constraints.hard_deadline_reason: Interim Istanbul management arrangement expires; critical supply chain window for dysprosium/neodymium compounds.

priority_capabilities.must_have_1: Proven senior leadership in high-conflict geopolitical environments
priority_capabilities.must_have_2: Complex stakeholder management across adversarial parties (Dealer groups, Governments)
priority_capabilities.must_have_3: Supply chain resilience and alternative logistics routing under sanctions
priority_capabilities.nice_to_have_2: Existing network in MENA trade and security circles
explicit_disqualifiers: Low tolerance for physical security risk

key_stakeholders.sensitivity_note: High-revenue partner requiring direct, high-trust senior representation on the ground.
Requires frequent, high-precision briefings on regional volatility.

classification.classification_reasoning: Scenario explicitly describes a geopolitical escalation and an urgent leadership vacancy in a conflict zone.

crisis_mgmt.business_logic: Crisis management is necessary for the conflict zone but secondary to the relational trust needed to hold the dealer network together.

ops_depth.business_logic: Supply chain depth is required but subservient to the geopolitical and relational navigation.

change_adapt.business_logic: Novel environment with no playbook requires a leader who can adapt to shifting military and political realities.

stakeholder.business_logic: The primary demand is holding the trust of a critical dealer group and the BMW board during a period of extreme volatility.

external_net.business_logic: Requires immediate access to sanctions legal experts and regional security networks.

floor_constraints.description: Minimum acceptable score per dimension for this scenario.

active_floors.floor_reasoning: Failure to build immediate trust with the Israel dealer group will lead to revenue collapse in a key market.
A rigid, process-only leader will break in this shifting conflict environment.

floor_constraints.floor_derivation_logic: Floors are set high for soft-power dimensions where failure results in immediate irreparable relationship damage.

dimension_correlation_warnings.description: Flags pairs of dimensions that are structurally correlated in this scenario.

correlated_pairs.scenario_specific_note: In MENA, external networking often overlaps significantly with formal stakeholder management.

scenario_intelligence.scenario_summary: Demands a diplomatic heavyweight who can maintain dealer trust and reroute supply chains under active conflict and sanctions pressure. A traditional 'operations-first' manager will likely fail here by prioritizing process over the delicate political and relational navigation required.

hidden_complexity_flags.description: Conflict escalation could render any strategy obsolete within days.
hidden_complexity_flags.impact_on_analysis: Prioritize candidates with high ambiguity tolerance and 'ground-up' regional experience.

candidate_archetypes_to_seek.archetype_description: Combines operational logic with high-level political and relational intelligence.
candidate_archetypes_to_seek.why_fit_this_scenario: Can navigate the board, the dealers, and the logistics corridors simultaneously.
candidate_archetypes_to_seek.typical_weakness: May be less focused on long-term internal process optimization.

candidate_archetypes_to_avoid.archetype_description: Thrives in stable, predictable environments with clear playbooks.
candidate_archetypes_to_avoid.why_wrong_for_this_scenario: Will be paralyzed by the lack of existing cooperation agreements and shifting conflict lines.

scenario_specific_interview_themes.rationale: Must keep the dealer group engaged when the physical presence of the brand is under threat.
scenario_specific_interview_themes.suggested_question: Tell us about a time you had to maintain a high-stakes partnership when you could not fulfill your core operational promises due to external volatility.
